versions.changelog:
Initial release of VMEG media translation skill.

- Provides video/audio/subtitle translation, material and task management, and export via VMEG.
- Requires VMEG Remote MCP configuration (OAuth or API key authentication).
- Strictly follows MCP server instructions for tool usage and document routing.
- Platform-specific setup and troubleshooting guidance included for major AI coding agents.
- Supplementary instructions for handling local video/audio uploads.
